'''2011 Bespin Regionals Jenkins LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jenkins]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing|V16-L-communing.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Communing v7
* '''Username:''' Stinkins
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
